decisions.statement: A custom pin type is registered with the game's own world map pin manager.
A registered pin type is reached by its name or by its number.
A pin type gets a checkbox on every map filter panel.
A filter checkbox reads and writes the saved variables the caller hands in.
The gamepad filter list is rebuilt from the entries this library has.
A caller reaches this library through a game global rather than an import.

definition: an addon library adding custom pins and their filter checkboxes to the world map
